newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - April 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE hits back at claims made to the U.S. government that the UAE has weak patent laws to protect pharmaceuticals.
- Dubai's trade prospects with Iraq in a post-sanctions era will hinge partly on the movements of the Iraqi dinar rates, Dubai Department of Economic Development chief says.
- The UAE telecommunications company Etisalat launches new data transmission mode.
- The Bangkok-based Santa Crafts Company Ltd is in talks with local partners in Dubai about setting up an office and warehouse for marketing porcelain dolls in the Gulf.
